SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: WATER
Subject: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES · Grade: Grade 1
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Water helps you succeed in ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES. You will understand it, practise it, and use it in your school compound, home, farm, or county.

KEY FACTS ABOUT WATER
We use water for drinking, cooking, cleaning, and farming.
Conserve water: close taps, fix leaks, reuse grey water for plants where safe.
Unsafe water can cause disease — store drinking water in clean covered containers.

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Water to a classmate.

5. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Water: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.

3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 1 learner study Water?
